name: ideal-knowledge-base (idealkb)
how: A pull request to the repository with the change to the generic file; a base that changed a generic file sees it as the diff follow.sh reports (exit 3) - send that diff. Record it here as an upstream item (ikb upstream-item --upstream idealkb --form patch --file auto).
notes: Where the standing tables, the generic queries and records, ikb and install-ikb.sh come from; the pin is idealkb.toml.

name: device-template
how: A pull request to the template with what every device would need (a part of the parts contract, a phone query, a test-run change); a finding about the template is an upstream item of form information.
notes: Where this base's device layer comes from: the parts contract (devicebase.toml), the phone queries, the records part, device, backlog-status, backlog-needs and test-run.
